reviews.body:
Thanks for the fix, the behaviour change looks right to me, and the regression test covers it well.

One change would be much appreciated:

`Run` already resolves `continue_on_error` for this configuration, so could you pass that value into `TestQueries` instead of looking it up again here?

comments.body:
Updated TestQueries to accept the continue_on_error value resolved by Run, and adjusted the direct test calls. The complete Go test suite passes.

This comment was drafted with Claude Code.

@pcbeingused333 thanks again. Your PR made me look deeper into continue_on_error and continue_on_query_testing_errors, and we refactored it quite a bit in https://github.com/grafana/sigma-rule-deployment/pull/456. Could you rebase on main to resolve the conflicts and use the new `continueOnQueryTestingErrors` variable?

Merged main (including #456) to resolve the conflicts, and switched `TestQueries` and the regression test to the new `continueOnQueryTestingErrors` / `ContinueOnQueryTestingErrors` setting. I merged rather than rebased to avoid a force push on the published branch; happy to rebase instead if you prefer. The complete Go test suite passes.

This comment was drafted with Claude Code.
